    15→// Expired reports whether the hold has lapsed at now.
    16→func (h Hold) Expired(now time.Time) bool {
    17→	return h.TTL > 0 && now.Sub(h.CreatedAt) > h.TTL
    18→}

content.thinking: Hold.Expired uses TTL, but store never sets TTL -> TTL == 0 -> Expired always false. ExpiresAt is populated. Want to confirm with running server.

content.text: `Hold.Expired` only returns true when `TTL > 0`, and the store never fills `TTL` in when it loads holds, so loaded holds never expire. Let me start the server and reproduce against the API to be sure.
